import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_0.csv"
source_1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_1.csv"
source_2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_2.csv"
source_3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_3.csv"

source_5_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_5.csv"
source_6_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_6.csv"
source_7_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_7.csv"
source_8_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/training_8.csv"

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_0_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'counts']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_1_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'counts']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_2_path, index_col=0)  # ['boro', 'zipcode']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_3_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'total_crime', 'violation', 'misdemeanor', 'felony']
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_4_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_5_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'indicator', 'counts']
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_6_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_7_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']
df8 = pd.read_csv(source_8_path, index_col=0)  # ['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']

# --- Transformation Plan ---
# Target columns:
# ['zipcode': int,
#  'businesses_x': str, 'counts_x': int,
#  'businesses_y': str, 'counts_y': int,
#  'businesses_x_5': str, 'counts_x_6': int,
#  'businesses_y_7': str, 'counts_y_8': int,
#  'boro': str,
#  'counts_x_10': int, 'counts_y_11': int,
#  'indicator': str,
#  'counts': int,
#  'total_crime': int,
#  'violation': int,
#  'misdemeanor': int,
#  'felony': int]

# Observations:
# - df6 (source6) has businesses='Sidewalk Cafe' and counts -> target businesses_x, counts_x
# - df4 (source4) has businesses='Pawnbroker' and counts -> target businesses_y, counts_y
# - df7 (source7) has businesses='Debt Collection Agency' and counts -> target businesses_x_5, counts_x_6
# - df8 (source8) has businesses='Cigarette Retail Dealer' and counts -> target businesses_y_7, counts_y_8
# - df2 has boro and zipcode
# - df0 and df1 have zipcode and counts, which correspond to counts_x_10 and counts_y_11 respectively
# - df5 has zipcode, indicator, counts (indicator and counts)
# - df3 has zipcode and crime stats (total_crime, violation, misdemeanor, felony)

# Step 1: Extract each business/count pair from df4, df6, df7, df8 by filtering their unique business names
# Step 2: Rename columns to match target columns
# Step 3: Merge all these business/count pairs on 'zipcode'
# Step 4: Merge df0 and df1 counts as counts_x_10 and counts_y_11 on zipcode
# Step 5: Merge boro from df2 on zipcode
# Step 6: Merge indicator and counts from df5 on zipcode
# Step 7: Merge crime stats from df3 on zipcode
# Step 8: Final projection and reorder columns to match target schema

# Extract and rename business/count pairs from df6 (Sidewalk Cafe)
df_sidewalk = df6[df6['businesses'] == 'Sidewalk Cafe'][['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']].copy()
df_sidewalk.rename(columns={'businesses': 'businesses_x', 'counts': 'counts_x'}, inplace=True)

# Extract and rename business/count pairs from df4 (Pawnbroker)
df_pawn = df4[df4['businesses'] == 'Pawnbroker'][['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']].copy()
df_pawn.rename(columns={'businesses': 'businesses_y', 'counts': 'counts_y'}, inplace=True)

# Extract and rename business/count pairs from df7 (Debt Collection Agency)
df_debt = df7[df7['businesses'] == 'Debt Collection Agency'][['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']].copy()
df_debt.rename(columns={'businesses': 'businesses_x_5', 'counts': 'counts_x_6'}, inplace=True)

# Extract and rename business/count pairs from df8 (Cigarette Retail Dealer)
df_cigarette = df8[df8['businesses'] == 'Cigarette Retail Dealer'][['zipcode', 'businesses', 'counts']].copy()
df_cigarette.rename(columns={'businesses': 'businesses_y_7', 'counts': 'counts_y_8'}, inplace=True)

# Rename df0 and df1 counts for counts_x_10 and counts_y_11
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={'counts': 'counts_x_10'})
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={'counts': 'counts_y_11'})

# df5 has indicator and counts (indicator, counts)
df5_subset = df5[['zipcode', 'indicator', 'counts']].copy()

# df2 has boro and zipcode
df2_subset = df2[['zipcode', 'boro']].copy()

# df3 has crime stats
df3_subset = df3[['zipcode', 'total_crime', 'violation', 'misdemeanor', 'felony']].copy()

# Now merge all on 'zipcode' step by step

# Start with df_sidewalk as base
df_merged = df_sidewalk

# Merge Pawnbroker (businesses_y, counts_y)
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df_pawn, on='zipcode', how='outer')

# Merge Debt Collection Agency (businesses_x_5, counts_x_6)
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df_debt, on='zipcode', how='outer')

# Merge Cigarette Retail Dealer (businesses_y_7, counts_y_8)
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df_cigarette, on='zipcode', how='outer')

# Merge boro from df2
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df2_subset, on='zipcode', how='left')

# Merge counts_x_10 from df0_renamed
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df0_renamed[['zipcode', 'counts_x_10']], on='zipcode', how='left')

# Merge counts_y_11 from df1_renamed
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df1_renamed[['zipcode', 'counts_y_11']], on='zipcode', how='left')

# Merge indicator and counts from df5
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df5_subset, on='zipcode', how='left')

# Merge crime stats from df3
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df3_subset, on='zipcode', how='left')

# Fill missing business columns with empty string (string columns)
business_cols = ['businesses_x', 'businesses_y', 'businesses_x_5', 'businesses_y_7']
for col in business_cols:
    if col in df_merged.columns:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].fillna('')

# Fill missing integer count columns with 0
count_cols = ['counts_x', 'counts_y', 'counts_x_6', 'counts_y_8', 'counts_x_10', 'counts_y_11', 'counts',
              'total_crime', 'violation', 'misdemeanor', 'felony']
for col in count_cols:
    if col in df_merged.columns:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Fill missing 'boro' with empty string
if 'boro' in df_merged.columns:
    df_merged['boro'] = df_merged['boro'].fillna('')

# Fill missing 'indicator' with empty string
if 'indicator' in df_merged.columns:
    df_merged['indicator'] = df_merged['indicator'].fillna('')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'zipcode',
    'businesses_x', 'counts_x',
    'businesses_y', 'counts_y',
    'businesses_x_5', 'counts_x_6',
    'businesses_y_7', 'counts_y_8',
    'boro',
    'counts_x_10', 'counts_y_11',
    'indicator',
    'counts',
    'total_crime',
    'violation',
    'misdemeanor',
    'felony'
]

# Some columns might be missing if no data was present, add them with default values
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_merged.columns:
        if col in business_cols or col == 'boro' or col == 'indicator':
            df_merged[col] = ''
        else:
            df_merged[col] = 0

df_merged = df_merged[target_columns]

# Save the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_26/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_merged.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
